doc.title: Lanny Morgan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999

title: Current work with Natalie Cole and upcoming tours
summary: He describes his Natalie Cole travel, a college weekend and a European tour with Bill Holman's band.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah. Well what’s in the near future for you, besides your playing with Bill Berry tonight?

Well you know I’ve been traveling with Natalie Cole for the last six and a half years. In fact we just got back from the east coast with her a couple of weeks ago. I’m going to Elmhurst College around Chicago to do a jazz weekend, Mike Abene and myself and Bobby Shew and Maynard and the band is going to be there too, so that’s from the 25th of this month through the end of the month. And then she has some things throughout the year, one of them will be in Brazil I think for about three weeks, going to England in April with a small group. Do you know Vic Lewis? Have you ever heard of Vic Lewis?

Vic had a big band in London and now he’s sort of an entrepreneur. He’s bringing this small group over. This will be Pete Christlieb, Bill Perkins, myself, Carl Saunders, Ron Stout, Andy — don’t do this Lanny — the trombone player, a wonderful trombone player — Martin, Andy Martin, a young guy. Have you heard of any of those people?
Some of them. Pete Christlieb for sure.

Okay. So we’re going to do one night in London with a small band and the next night with Bill Holman’s band, he’s going to use us who are in the band anyway and supplement it with English players. And then he’s going — Phil Woods did a tour with a big band starting in Spain for a guy named Jordi Pujol who’s a booker over there. He’s a friend of Jordi Sunol, who has Fresh Sounds records. I may have those last names mixed up, but anyway we’ve got about five or six dates over there with Bill’s band over there. I think the North Sea Festival and a couple of dates in Portugal and things like that, and also I have a few things of my own, some involve traveling and some are in town.
